newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close higher on U.S. record runs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close higher on U.S. record runs.

text.p: Tokyo stocks strode upward by Thursday's close, boosted by record winning runs in the Dow industrials and the tech-riden Nasdaq composite index.
The yen's further retreat against the dollar also encouraged buying in export-driven blue-chip issues in Tokyo, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average gained 160.51 points or 0.79 percent to close at 20,519.25.
"Many people were still waiting to take profits above 20,500, but I have a feeling that sentiment is slightly changing," said Hiroyuki Nakai, chief investment strategist at Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
